adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~20 mm southward, ~2.5 mm eastward, ~20 mm downward offset from day 564 to 599 (P3), with clear return at day 600–601 (P6/P7). P1 (558–560) is a brief isolated dip without return; P2 (563) and P4/P5 (585–588) are isolated spikes not followed by opposing recovery. Hypotheses P1–P7 confirm only P3 has persistent interior level shift and coherent return across all axes. P6 and P7 share identical offsets and occur at the same time; only one platform needed for the return. Thus genuine temporary platform is P3 only.
